newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia hopes for rating similar to Greece, Spain.
newsitem.headline: Russia hopes for rating similar to Greece, Spain.

text.p: Russia hopes to get a credit rating similar to that of Greece, Spain, or Portugal for its first Eurobond issue, Economy Minister Yevgeny Yasin said on Tuesday.
He told reporters he would meet officials from a U.S. rating agency who came to Moscow on Monday later today, but did not name the rating agency.
The agency is the second to come to Moscow to draw up a rating for the Eurobond issue planned to be launched by the end of September or start of October.
A senior finance ministry official said this week that the rating would be ready and published by the end of September.

Russia agreed in principle last year with the London Club of commercial bank creditors to reschedule $35 billion of debt, paving the way for the Eurobond. Individual banks are now signing up to the deal.
